FN-VB04PP-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 278
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator J.T. Waggoner
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/03/2023
Senate Bill 278 as introduced creates the Distressed Institutions of Higher Education Loan
Program Fund in the State Treasury to receive appropriations from the Legislature for the
purpose of funding loans to eligible institutions of higher education experiencing financial
hardships that could lead to closure of the institution pursuant to the provisions of this bill. This
bill provides that proceeds from the loan repayments would be deposited into the fund, and that
any monies remaining in the fund at the end of the fiscal year shall not revert and shall be
reappropriated for the purposes of the program.
Additionally, this bill will increase the administrative obligations of the State Treasurer to
administer the Distressed Institutions of Higher Education Revolving Loan Program, as
authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
